description.brief: fart 25 tries to serve every thought of mechanics, and a quest to return the icecreams too! Currently in demo.
description.full:
fart 25 is a mod set after the defeat of the sun, where Papatopia suddenly notices that most of the ice creams have mysteriously disappeared! Society isn't happy, and now Beebo HAS to recover the ice creams to restore peace to Papatopia. But wait- there’s more! Dr. Smar, Beebo's creator, is also on this mission!

Play as both Beebo and Dr. Smar, and discover new mechanics, cutscenes, fun stuff plenty of more waiting for you to check out!

Bet your imaginations on fart 25.

description.brief: Play Robot 64 together, with your friends!
description.full:
What if robot 64 had ACTUAL multiplayer?
Play robot 64 with friends in the Robot 64 co-op mod, with most if not EVERYTHING syncing such as; Icecreams, candies, breakable boxes, items you can pick up, moving platforms, enemies, entire boss fights (yes, the final boss too) and more! You can even collide with other players!
This game is built upon the Robot 64 Engine by zKevin, but uses things from @D4WizardBoi's Robot 64 decomp (very turbo-thanks)
